name: Amarie Gelade
original_name: アマリエ・ジェラード
source:
Likes: Playing with lyre, Soope
Dislikes: Trashy people

A young woman who works as a ranger in a forest and an adventurer. She encounters Croix and his friends in a forest and starts to travel with them. She always takes Soope with her. He's been with her for as long as he can remember.
She works as a professional lyre player, as well as a ranger. Her lyre is also a versatile weapon: it can become a sword and a bow in battle. Where she is from is unknown. Due to her darker skin, some believe she is a Teru, but she doesn't have a tail or horns, the symbolical physical features of the Teru, so it seems quite certain that she is a human.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/AT2/]official site[/url]]
